text:
- **Go pm only:** Python pm is deleted from Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents. Every clone now runs Go pm, including the Linux server.
- **Harness records in Yeeef/pm:** pm-harness is tracked in Yeeef/pm with its full history. The yeeef-agents copy is closed.
- **Command and hook changes:** pm can move a sprint to another project in one command. pm clean removes merged agent worktrees. The owner-request hook now applies one rule.
- **Site and CI checks:** Wide diagrams stay readable and scroll sideways on a phone. The site keeps serving pages while git rewrites records. The slowest pull request check runs much faster.
